In-flight Chain strip v1.1-strip

One real autopilot flight (seed 7; Body Spark, Echo, Lift Guide, Resonant Harvest) recorded four times. Left: the whole screen. Right: the same moments magnified (nearest-neighbour) on the part that changes. Pick by code.

Back to the lab

v1.1-strip-A · Hollow frames (top centre, as shipped)

A small outlined frame per card at the top; it flashes white when the card fires, with an echo frame.

Strip, 4×

v1.1-strip-B · Cards at the bottom

Real mini cards bottom centre, clear of the thumb zones. A firing card jumps up, glows and a big +N rises; the card waiting to fire next has a lit top edge.

Cards, 4×

v1.1-strip-C · Side rail

A vertical rail on the left edge, one pip per slot. A bright bead runs down it to each firing pip, which bursts a ring; the Sparks gained by the whole resolution pop at the end of the rail.

Full screen
Rail, 3×

v1.1-strip-D · Burst at the Wisp

No strip while idle. When a card fires, its picture pops out beside the Wisp for 0.6 s (with +N when it paid Sparks), so the eye never leaves the Wisp.

Full screen
Around the Wisp, 3×

Same rules in all four: one flash at a time (0.7 s), one pending flash per card, no text to read in flight. Try one in the game with ?strip=a|b|c|d on game.html. Made by scripts/variant-clips.mjs with --zoom.
